name: IG30PTCO Water Color Sensor
shortDescription: Optical absorption measures water color against the platinum-cobalt color scale. Automatic turbidity compensation and a cleaning brush support online monitoring, while stored calibration settings and digital communication simplify connection to water monitoring systems at the installation site.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Digital sensor, RS-485 output, MODBUS protocol
◆Equipped with an automatic cleaning brush to prevent contamination and eliminate bubbles
◆ Automatically compensates for turbidity interference and has good testing performance
◆ Built in calibration parameters, precisely calibrated at the factory, can be directly installed and used
Application areas:
Drinking water monitoring, surface water monitoring, hospitals, industrial enterprises, environmental protection
Technical parameters:
Measurement range: 0-50Pt Co
Measurement principle: optical method (platinum cobalt color standard)
Measurement accuracy: ± 2% FS
Repeatability: less than ± 2%
Sensor material: Body: SUS316L； Window: Sapphire
Self cleaning: automatic scraping brush
Sensor communication: MODBUS RS-485 
Storage temperature:- 10~50℃ 
Working temperature: 0~50 ℃ (non freezing)
Protection level: IP68 
Power consumption:< 2W
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Sensor size: 212mm * 50mm
